answer: Retrospective Behavior Kernel Scoring. After each epoch, score every identity by the statistical kernel density of its transaction timing, counterparty overlap, and amount distribution against the whole population; clusters of near-identical profiles get flagged and their gains clawed back. Honest users spread across a wide willow of behavior patterns, while sybils must spend real compute and capital to imitate distinct histories for each fake identity. The canyon between synthetic and organic profiles is the detection gap an attacker cannot cheaply cross.
